meta.name: 日式法务编辑风 / Japanese Legal Editorial
meta.description: 从内藤与大塚律师事务所网页及 8 张参考截图提炼的编辑型视觉系统：纸张噪点、黑白纪实摄影、炭灰章节、朱红点睛、超大衬线英文和严格建筑网格。
source_references: 内藤与大塚律师事务所.html

color.palette_type: restrained editorial duotone with a single vermilion signal accent

primary.role: ink-blue typography, rules and structural navigation

accent.role: small bullets, signal blocks and pagination highlights only

neutral.usage: warm paper canvas, muted labels, hairline separators and charcoal inverse sections

color.contrast_strategy: alternate warm-paper and charcoal chapters; preserve near-black text and reserve vermilion for less than 8% of each frame

font_families.heading: Cormorant Garamond, Noto Serif SC, serif
font_families.body: Zen Kaku Gothic New, Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Use high-contrast serif for giant English editorial statements; use geometric Japanese grotesk for Chinese/Japanese information; vertical CJK titles are allowed as structural markers.

spacing.content_density: medium-low with occasional dense editorial lists
spacing.section_rhythm: large 80–160px breathing zones separated by full-width hairlines

layout.grid_system: 12-column editorial grid with visible hairline guides and asymmetric 3/5/4 compositions

border_radius.large: 0–24px only on the outer page frame

shape.border_usage: 1px ink-blue or warm-gray rules form the composition
shape.divider_style: long horizontal hairlines with arrow terminals

elevation.shadow_style: almost flat; photography and color blocks provide depth
elevation.depth_cues: image overlap, crops, large scale contrast and alternating surface colors

iconography.style: minimal line arrows and tiny solid signal dots
iconography.preferred_set: custom inline SVG arrows rather than illustrative icon packs

motion.easing: ease; linear for image fades and scroll masks
motion.entrance_pattern: masked vertical reveal, opacity fade and image wipe
motion.exit_pattern: quiet fade or continuation beyond viewport
motion.philosophy: slow, deliberate, cinematic motion that never competes with legal content

components.button_style: flat text CTA between hairlines with a rectangular arrow cell
components.input_style: minimal underline field with no rounded container
components.card_style: borderless editorial block or squared image crop
components.navigation_pattern: thin fixed header with widely spaced labels
components.modal_style: flat paper overlay with strong typographic hierarchy
components.list_style: single-line rows divided by hairlines and right-facing arrows
components.component_notes: Prefer spatial hierarchy over boxes; red dots label chapters and small metadata.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a contemporary legal journal printed on archival paper
aesthetic.era_influence: modern Japanese editorial design with 1960s Swiss grid discipline

visual_language.ornamentation: paper grain, oversized typography and archival marks only
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: one dominant text or image anchor balanced by small metadata
visual_language.focal_strategy: extreme scale contrast plus a single vermilion signal
visual_language.contrast_level: high tonal contrast, low chromatic variety
visual_language.texture_usage: persistent fine paper grain and photocopy-like image noise

composition.hierarchy_method: scale, crop and grid position rather than cards
composition.flow_direction: left-to-right with occasional vertical Japanese markers
composition.grouping_strategy: hairlines, shared baselines and large negative-space zones
composition.negative_space_role: establishes authority and slows reading rhythm

imagery.photo_treatment: high-grain monochrome documentary photography, deep blacks, slightly warm highlights
imagery.illustration_style: rare; use utilitarian diagrams, barcodes or archival marks
imagery.graphic_elements: vermilion rectangles, red dots, thin rules, arrows, oversized serif words
imagery.pattern_usage: fine noise and subtle scan-line texture across paper surfaces
imagery.image_shape: strict rectangles, hard crops, edge-to-edge panels and editorial collage

interaction_feel.feedback_style: subtle arrow travel and opacity change
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: image scale up 1–2% or row-arrow slide
interaction_feel.loading_style: minimal red indicator or paper-mask reveal

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: short noun/verb labels such as 更多 / VIEW
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: editorial whitespace with one explanatory line

overview.fallback_strategy: retain static paper texture, final frame and readable content when motion is disabled
overview.primary_technology: CSS, SVG, Splide and GSAP ScrollTrigger

background_effects.description: subtle monochrome noise repeated over warm paper and image surfaces

particle_systems.description: Reference site uses paper grain rather than particles.

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: height wipe, opacity reveal and pinned chapter transition

scroll_morphing.description: Full-height overlay masks collapse during service-section scrolling.

text_effects.description: Display text exceeds the viewport and is intentionally clipped like a magazine spread.

image_effects.type: monochrome grain, fade carousel and crop reveal
image_effects.description: Photographs are desaturated, contrast-rich and revealed slowly in squared editorial frames.
image_effects.technology: CSS filters, Splide fade and GSAP ScrollTrigger
